title: Anonymize Selected Slide Text (StorylineAndReview)

scenarios.title: Anonymize Selected Slide Text applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Anonymize Selected Slide Text (BtnAnonymize) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Anonymization placeholder generation is pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: Each letter or digit position of the original text is replaced with a random letter from the lorem vocabulary (digits become letters), while string length, whitespace, punctuation and symbol positions are preserved verbatim and per-position letter case is retained; output is deterministic for a given Random seed.

scenarios.title: Anonymize Selected Slide Text replaces every word in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Anonymize Selected Slide Text on one text box reading quarterly report by sample person shows its YesNo confirmation (the driver measures dialogSeen=True and dismisses with a synthetic key press), replaces every word with a generated placeholder (measured textChanged=True originalGone=True, none of the original words remain), returns true, writes no new entry in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and leaves the host stable.

snapshotNotice: Source scenario inventory only; ready/planned/blocked are planning states, not passing results. Office runner scripts and maintainer release evidence are not distributed with this source snapshot.
